summary_zh: 今日越南製造業焦點在融資與綠色轉型：Techcombank、越南外貿銀行推出生產經營優惠信貸，回應持續升溫的融資成本痛點。綠色基礎設施成為工業區選址要件，機電與紡織回收業面臨新標準壓力；湄公河三角洲勞工短缺推高留才成本，機器人取代組裝人力需求升高。
summary_en: Banks (Techcombank, Vietcombank) rolled out lower-rate production loans as financing costs stay a top pain. Green infrastructure is becoming a site-selection criterion, while mechanical-electrical and textile recycling face green standards. Mekong labour shortages raise retention costs and automation demand.
